RENOVATION FINANCING
Dream about the home.
Talk through the financing.

A larger renovation starts with two conversations: what you want to build, and how you plan to fund it.

EXPLORE YOUR OPTIONS WITH PRIMELENDING
A conversation today.
A clearer plan ahead.

PrimeLending offers renovation loan options for eligible homeowners and homebuyers. Depending on the program, renovation costs may be included in a purchase or refinance mortgage.

Stephanie Hecke can explain the available programs and help you understand the requirements for your property, finances, and renovation goals.

Explore PrimeLending renovation programs

All loans are subject to credit approval. Conditions and restrictions may apply. Rates, fees, eligibility, and terms are determined by PrimeLending. This page is an introduction to a financing resource, not a loan offer or an approval.

PrimeLending
A PlainsCapital Company · NMLS #13649 · Equal Housing Lender
YOUR FINANCING CONTACT
Stephanie Hecke

Loan Originator · NMLS #1539979

(501) 514-5525
stephanie.hecke@primelending.com
Apply with PrimeLending

Opens PrimeLending’s secure application website.

TWO TEAMS. A COORDINATED STARTING POINT.
Define the work.
Understand the options.
01
Talk to Alpha

Share your home, ideas, priorities, and the scope you have in mind.

02
Talk to your lender

Review your financial situation, property, and potential renovation programs with Stephanie.

03
Prepare the details

Develop a construction estimate and provide the project information your lender requests.

04
Align the next steps

Confirm the lender’s requirements and construction arrangements before scheduling work.

Alpha General Construction provides construction services. PrimeLending provides lending services and makes all credit decisions. Loan documents and financial information should be submitted directly to the lender.

BEHIND THE BUILD
Shower Remodel Playbook: The Questions Pros Wish You’d Ask (Before Demo Day)
By Joel Gomez Rivas · November 12, 2025 · 5 min read

Behind the Build — by Alpha

Why the right questions matter
Most shower headaches start before demo—unclear scope, hidden water issues, or “we thought that was included.” Ask tight, practical questions and you’ll win three things: a cleaner scope, a realistic schedule, and a watertight shower that still looks good a year from now.

How to use this guide: These are the same questions we walk through with our clients—and the standards we hold ourselves to at Alpha.

Part 1 — Ask yourself (before you call anyone)
Goals & constraints

What problem are we solving first—leaks, layout, style, accessibility, or all of the above?

Must‑haves vs. nice‑to‑haves: niche, bench, handheld, rain head, steam, curbless.

Budget range: base / realistic / walk‑away.

Any timeline constraints—holidays, guests, travel?

Look & maintenance

Tile size/pattern? (Large‑format needs flatter walls and careful layout.)

Stone vs. porcelain? Stone looks rich but needs more care; porcelain is easier.

Grout type and color tolerance (epoxy = low maintenance; cement = more porous).

Accessibility

Is curbless important? It may require framing changes, lowering the subfloor, and a linear‑drain plan.

Part 2 — Ask your contractor (and what strong answers sound like)
Waterproofing (non‑negotiable)

Which system—sheet membrane, liquid, or foam board—and where does it start/stop?
Look for a named system and a clear plan: walls, niche, bench, curb, and pan all tied together.

Flood‑test the pan before tile? How long?
24‑hour flood test is standard; longer is better.

Shower pan & slope

How is the pan built and sloped?
Expect about ¼″ per foot to the drain with proper drain height.

Curbless or curb

If curbless, what structural changes are needed?
Recessed floor, sistered joists, or a linear drain to control water at the entry.

Drain & plumbing

Are we relocating the drain/valves? If yes, what’s the plan for slab patching or framing and venting checks?

Penetrations & movement

How will you waterproof niches, valve penetrations, benches, and fasteners?

Where are movement joints planned? (They reduce cracking on larger tiled areas.)

Glass

When is glass measured and what’s the lead time?
Measured after tile; plan for 1–3 weeks before install.

Schedule

What are the milestones and sequence?
Typical: demo → rough plumbing/electrical → inspections (if required) → pan + waterproof → flood test → tile → grout → glass → punch list.

Allowances & exclusions

What’s included in your price vs. allowance vs. owner‑supplied?
Confirm tile, grout, thinset, drains, valves/trim, niche trim, and glass.

What’s excluded? (Common: paint, baseboards, transitions, vent fan, drywall beyond wet area.)

Change orders

If I change tile/fixtures mid‑stream, how is pricing handled?
Simple change‑order form and a daily delay rate if the crew is waiting on decisions.

Protection & cleanup

How will you protect adjacent floors and control dust?

What’s the daily cleanup standard and the final haul‑off plan?

Warranty & documentation

What’s your labor warranty, and do you photo‑document waterproofing before tile?
Get the warranty in writing, and make sure the shower pan and waterproofing are explicitly covered.

Part 3 — Compare bids (without getting burned)

Line items over lump sums. Quantities in writing: tile SF/LF, pan type, niche/bench count, glass, drain type, plumbing moves.

Waterproofing called out by brand/system. Make it a line item; include flood‑test notes.

Allowances that match your taste. A $250 “shower trim” allowance won’t cover luxury fixtures.

Schedule assumptions. Custom glass usually adds 1–3 weeks.

Change‑order language. Clear forms + clear rates = fewer “gotchas.”

Part 4 — Curbless showers: gorgeous, but plan for them

Structure: lowering the pan or recessing joists may be required.

Drain strategy: linear drains simplify slope and reduce tile cuts at the entry.

Water containment: plan glass layout and opening width on day one.

Continuous waterproofing: pan, walls, and entry must be one system.

Part 5 — Aftercare that protects your warranty

Use the cleaner the tile/grout manufacturer recommends (skip harsh acids).

Squeegee glass and wipe corners; run the fan during and after showers.

If something looks off, take photos and email your contractor—small issues are easiest to fix early.

Why partners matter (and who we trust)

A contractor with trusted vendor partners saves you time, reduces order errors, and keeps quality high. We don’t hand you a shopping list and wish you luck—we connect you with the exact people who make selections easy and get orders right the first time. It’s not laziness; it’s professional delegation to pros who live in product and logistics all day.

Tile & Surfaces — Yates Flooring Center
We send square footage, your notes, and your contact info. They handle samples, quotes, and orders.
Contact: Destini King — Yates Flooring Center — ✆ (432) 556-5043 | 📧 Destini@yatesflooring.com

Plumbing Fixtures — Ferguson Bath, Kitchen & Lighting Gallery
For valves, trims, faucets, sinks, and vanities we recommend Ferguson for quality, parts availability, and warranty support.
Contact: Eric Gonzalez — Ferguson — ✆ (432) 352-7284 | 📧 Eric.Gonzales1@ferguson.com

Will we install homeowner‑purchased items from elsewhere? Yes. But if this is your primary residence, you’re already investing thousands—splurge on the valve/trim you’ll use every day and that actually carries strong warranty support.

Our method at Alpha (how we build for the long run)
1) Pan and surface waterproofing (belt + suspenders)

We build the pan to code and flood‑test it, then use a surface‑applied waterproofing (e.g., RedGard) on the walls, niche, bench, and curb so water never travels through the substrate. It’s more labor and cost—but it protects your home and our name. We follow a single, continuous system so the assembly dries as designed.

2) Lasers, levels, and smart sequencing

We set tile with lasers and long levels to keep planes true and lines dead‑straight. We wait to tape and bed drywall around the shower until tile is in so the tile edge becomes the perfect reference, there’s no mud dust in fresh thinset, and your reveals/trim lines stay clean.

3) Workmanship over “just the look”

Pretty photos don’t stop leaks. Prep, slope, coverage, sealed penetrations, and movement joints are what make a shower last. We document waterproofing, flood‑test the pan, and stand behind it with a written labor warranty.

Red flags (press pause if you hear these)

“We don’t flood‑test.”

“We just RedGard everything.” (with no system plan or thickness checks)

“Drywall is fine in the shower if you seal it.”

“We’ll set the glass, then see where it leaks.”

“No fan needed—just crack a window.”

What to do next:

Grab the checklist and mark your must‑haves.

Lock materials with a pro salesperson (tile + fixtures) so orders land clean.

Sit down with your contractor and walk the plan: waterproofing, flood test, schedule, allowances, and warranty.

BEHIND THE BUILD
Preparing for a Kitchen Remodel: Building More Than Cabinets
By Joel Gomez Rivas · June 26, 2025 · 4 min read

There’s something sacred about the kitchen. It’s where quiet mornings begin. Where birthdays are baked, and dinner becomes therapy. It’s the place that wears the fingerprints of your family. The soundtrack of your home starts here.

So when someone decides to remodel their kitchen, they’re not just upgrading countertops—they’re reshaping the way life flows through the house.

That’s why preparing for a kitchen remodel shouldn’t begin with catalogs or color swatches. It should begin with the way you live. What matters to you? What drives you crazy? What do you wish this space could do that it doesn’t?

This guide isn’t a checklist. It’s a conversation. A way to walk through the decisions that matter—before they get poured in concrete.

What No One Sees (But You’ll Feel Every Day)

The parts of the kitchen you don’t see—the wiring, venting, outlets, shutoffs—are the parts you feel most when they’re missing or wrong.

Planning for function isn’t glamorous, but it’s foundational:

Will you need outlets in your island for baking days or charging laptops?

Do your mornings feel dim or shadowy? Layered lighting—task, ambient, and accent—can change everything.

Filtered water or a pot filler? They may seem like small luxuries, but they’re plumbing decisions that need to be planned early.

Do you cook late or early? Dimmers and switch locations matter more than you think.

These are the choices that affect how your kitchen works when no one else is watching.

Cost Isn’t the Enemy—Surprise Is

Most people don’t go over budget because they’re careless. They go over because they didn’t know what to expect.

Here’s what we’ve learned from walking people through this process again and again:

Cabinets: Semi-custom cabinetry typically ranges from $12,000 to $25,000+. Custom starts closer to $30,000.

Countertops: Quartz, granite, and quartzite range from $50–$100+ per square foot installed.

Plumbing/Electrical: If you’re adding lights, outlets, or relocating appliances, expect $3,000–$8,000 in upgrades.

Design & Project Management: If you're hiring someone to manage the entire job (and you should), plan on an additional 10–20% for daily oversight and scheduling.

Always reserve 10–15% of your budget for the unknowns. Especially in older homes, walls can hold surprises—structural issues, hidden damage, or outdated wiring.

And time? A full kitchen remodel typically takes 6–10 weeks, depending on the size of the space, how fast materials arrive, and the level of customization involved.

Is White Still “In”? Or Just Safe?

White kitchens are still a favorite. They're clean, timeless, and easy to build around.

But timeless doesn’t mean trendless. It means balanced—a mix of neutral tones, layered textures, and smart contrasts.

Some of the kitchens we love most lately feature:

Soft taupe or greige cabinets

Deep navy or woodland green islands

Matte black hardware and brass accents

Light oak flooring for warmth

A white kitchen with butcher block and bold lighting? Timeless. A slate blue kitchen with warm lighting and texture-rich backsplash? Also timeless—if it fits the home.

Don’t chase trends. Choose what feels like peace at 6am when the house is quiet and coffee is brewing.

Choosing a Countertop: What You See vs. What You Live With

Your countertop isn't just a surface. It’s where the life of your kitchen unfolds.

Here’s a breakdown of what’s out there—and what you might want to live with:

Quartz: Durable, low-maintenance, and consistent in color. Ideal for families and daily cooking.

Granite: Natural and unique. Heat-resistant. Requires occasional sealing.

Marble: Elegant, soft, and prone to scratches. Better for baking and light use areas.

Quartzite: Strong like granite, beautiful like marble. Premium choice, but worth the investment.

Butcher Block: Warm and homey. Needs maintenance, but ages with character.

Laminate: Modern patterns at a lower cost. Less durable, but good for budget projects.

Each material has its personality. The right one depends on yours.

(We’ll dive deeper into each option in Part Two.)

A Real Example: Tuberose Kitchen

We called this one the Tuberose Kitchen—not just because of the finishes, but because of what it taught us.

It came together beautifully: white shaker cabinets, Calacatta quartz, a warm butcher block island, matte black fixtures, and soft brass accents. The photos turned out great—but the process was what stayed with us.

The homeowner talked a lot about trusting the process. She stayed involved, communicated her vision clearly, and gave us the freedom to build with care. Near the end of the job, we missed the mark—there was a lingering issue we didn’t resolve quickly enough. She gave us honest feedback about how it made her feel, and we could tell we’d let her down.

We owned it. We apologized. We tried to make it right, but sometimes resolution comes too late to undo the weight of disappointment.

And yet—months later, she reached back out to order additional doors from us. She didn’t have to. But she did. That moment reminded us that how you recover matters just as much as how you build.

🖼 See the Tuberose Kitchen here →

Final Thought

A kitchen remodel is more than a project. It’s a transition.

You’re not just rebuilding cabinets—you’re reimagining the way your home feels when people walk in, sit down, or gather after a long day.

Prepare with intention. Be honest about your needs. Expect a few bumps. And surround yourself with people who don’t just want to build—but want to build something right.

Planning a kitchen renovation in Midland? Book a consultation with Joel to discuss your priorities, selections, and project-specific budget.

AZ New Bath Referral Program

Welcome to AZ New Bath's Referral Program! We value our customers and believe in rewarding those who spread the word about our quality services. To show our appreciation, we offer a $300 referral bonus for every successful referral.

HOW THE AZ NEW BATH REFERRAL PROGRAM WORKS

Refer A Friend: Any past AZ New Bath client can refer a friend, family member, or loved one to AZ New Bath. 

Mention Referral During Consultation: During the consultation, the referred individual mentions the name of the person who referred them.

Leave a Review: The referrer must leave a review of AZ New Bath on Google to activate the reward. 

When You Get Paid: The referral must result in a completed project to be eligible for the reward. Once the project is completed and the invoice has been paid, you get paid for your referral bonus.

GET STARTED

Ready to earn a referral bonus? Get started by referring someone to AZ New Bath today!

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA 

Who is Eligible: Past clients of AZ New Bath.

Completed Project: The referral must result in a completed project.

Google Review: The referrer must leave a review on Google to activate the referral bonus.

LEAVE A REVIEW

How will money be received? The referral bonus will be issued either in a check or Zelle, upon completion of the referred project.

Can I refer multiple people? Yes! You can refer multiple people and earn multiple referral bonuses. Start spreading the word!

Can I refer anyone? Of course! There are no restrictions on who you can refer. 

TERMS AND CONDITIONS 

The referral program operates on an ongoing basis. There are no limitations on the number of referrals per client. Rewards are subject to eligibility criteria, and issuance will be in accordance with these conditions.

Terms and conditions apply. AZ New Bath reserves the right to modify or terminate the referral program at any time without prior notice. Referral bonuses are subject to verification and may be withheld if eligibility criteria are not met.

THE SECRET TO A STRESS-FREE BATHROOM REMODEL
Jonathan Sands  Bathroom Remodel
The Secret to a Stress-Free Bathroom Remodel

Are you dreaming of a bathroom remodel that's smooth, stress-free, and hassle-free? At AZ New Bath, we understand that a bathroom renovation can be a significant undertaking. 

We are here to make the process as easy and enjoyable as possible for you.

HASSLE-FREE BATHROOM REMODELING: OUR PROVEN PROCESS

With years of experience under our belt, we've perfected a hassle-free bathroom remodeling process that puts your needs first. Our dedicated team of experts is committed to turning your bathroom dreams into reality, without the commonly associated with renovations.

STEP 1: PERSONALIZED CONSULTATION

We begin with a personalized consultation where we take the time to listen to your ideas, preferences, and goals for your bathroom. Our experienced designers will work closely with you to understand your unique needs in order to create a customized plan tailored to your style and budget.

HOW MUCH DOES IT COST TO REMODEL A BATHROOM?
Jonathan Sands  Bathroom Remodel
How Much Does it Cost to Remodel a Bathroom?

Remodeling your bathroom can greatly enhance the value of your home. It’s one of the most rewarding areas to remodel in your home because a few small changes can make a big impact on the look and functionality of the space. A bathroom remodel can increase the value of your home while also making your home more enjoyable to live in. 

Whatever your reasons for remodeling, the first question on most homeowners' minds is, “how much does it cost to remodel a bathroom?”

TYPICAL COST OF REMODELING A BATHROOM

A bathroom remodel can be a daunting task for homeowners. This doesn’t have to be the case if you work with the right contractor. A good remodeling contractor will know how to make the most of the space based on your remodeling budget. The average cost of a bathroom remodel will depend on the scope, size, and features of the project.

The typical cost of a small-scale bathroom remodel is around $5,000 to $10,000. This includes minor updates such as new flooring, painting, or fixtures, and more significant changes like adding a new shower or bathtub, changing the room's layout, or adding storage space.

The typical cost of a medium-scale or primary bathroom remodel is around $15,000 to $25,000. A medium-scale update typically involves major upgrades like replacing major bathroom fixtures (i.e. sinks, toilets) as well as redoing plumbing lines.

Once you have an idea of everything that needs to get done to bring your vision to life, the next step is to shop around. It’s always a good idea to get a few quotes from different contractors so you can find the one who will give you the best price while also delivering quality work.

WHY YOU SHOULD REMODEL YOUR BATHROOM

Remodeling your bathroom can help you increase the value of your home, provide more space, and improve your home's appearance and functionality. Many people choose to remodel their bathroom for cosmetic reasons or more practical ones (accessibility). A bathtub to shower conversion can help seniors stay safe while maintaining independence in their homes. A shower conversion is a great way to make bathing more comfortable and safe for elderly folks.

WHAT IS THE MOST EXPENSIVE PART OF A BATHROOM REMODEL?

There are a number of factors that influence the average cost of remodeling your bathroom. The size of the room, the shape of the room, as well as what kind of functionality you're looking to have all play a role in determining the investment needed to remodel your bathroom.

The most expensive remodeling projects are those that require new plumbing, electrical wiring, and or major structural changes to the room. 

The type of material you choose for your new bathroom will impact its price as well. For example, porcelain tile is less expensive than marble but it’s not as durable or easy to maintain. The type of material you choose will also affect installation costs because some materials take longer to install than others. For example, tiles are cheaper but require more time and labor because they must be set individually

HOW TO SAVE MONEY ON A BATHROOM RENOVATION?

If you are looking for ways to save money on a bathroom renovation, then you need to be aware of some of the common mistakes people make when they start the project.

These mistakes could include:

Not planning ahead

Not making sure you have enough funds available before starting the project

Not getting all the necessary permits before starting construction

Starting without a final plan and then making changes

THE IDEAL STRATEGY TO SAVE ON YOUR BATHROOM REMODEL

Home remodeling can be a costly investment, but it doesn't have to be. There are many ways to save on your upcoming projects. One of the most important things is to set a realistic budget for your project. You should know what you can afford before getting started. Your budget should also include money for unforeseen expenses, like additional materials or labor costs that may come up during the project.

You should also consider hiring professional help if you are not experienced in this type of work or if the project is too big for you to handle on your own. Professional help not only saves time but also helps avoid mistakes that could cost more in the long run.

HIRING A PROFESSIONAL CONTRACTOR VS. DIY BATHROOM REMODEL

Hiring a professional for your bathroom remodel ensures that the tile work and plumbing connections are done right. Aside from DIY, your options are to employ a general contractor to handle every aspect of the bathroom remodel or engage a tiler and plumber separately. If you choose the latter, make sure to communicate your expectations to each party explicitly to prevent communication breakdowns. The best option is to hire a general contractor who can oversee the project for you and communicate effectively with each subcontractor.

HIRING A BATHROOM CONTRACTOR IN ARIZONA

A licensed professional contractor in Arizona will have the knowledge and experience to know whether your project will need any permits and, if so, how to obtain them.

Hiring a licensed professional contractor will also give you the advantage of knowing the project is done right. If you're looking to hire a bathroom contractor in Arizona, here are some things you should keep in mind:

If necessary get your HOA approval before starting any construction work

Check whether or not you need to get permits for your construction project

If you want your bathroom to be ADA compliant, make sure that it is at least 36" wide and 60" deep

HOW LONG DOES A BATHROOM REMODEL TAKE?
Jonathan Sands  Bathroom Remodel
How Long Does a Bathroom Remodel Take?

The bathroom is one of the most-used spaces in a home, and it's also the room that needs to be updated most often. A remodel can be time-consuming and expensive. It can also be stressful for homeowners. The best advice is not to let time be the deciding factor in your choice to put off remodeling that much-needed space in your home. Materials and resources for bathroom remodel contractors have come a long way and you have options to make the process take less time, be more cost-effective, and less stressful on you and your family.

CAN YOU REMODEL A BATHROOM IN ONE DAY?

 The scope of the bathroom remodel project is a major factor in determining whether or not you can remodel a bathroom in one day. It’s possible, but if your project requires moving plumbing or involves other contractors like electricians, one day is unlikely to happen. If you’re doing something relatively simple like replacing a bathtub with an acrylic shower, then yes, it’s possible to complete your bathroom remodel in one day.

No matter how quickly you need your bathroom remodeled, many contractors recommend choosing acrylic baths and showers made of non-porous material. Not only is installation quicker than tile, your bath will not chip, crack, or fade. Best of all, acrylic is easy to clean. No more intense scrubbing porous old tiles and grout.

FACTORS THAT AFFECT A BATHROOM REMODEL TIMELINE

A bathroom remodel is a big investment and many homeowners are not sure what they want done until they know the cost and how much time it will take. Here are some important factors to consider when planning your next bathroom remodel.

TYPE OF REMODEL

Bathroom remodel contractors typically can give you a general idea of how long the project will take. But, there are many factors that can affect the timeline. For example, if you are looking to convert your bathtub to a shower and want to add on a toilet, that will affect the timeline. 

Cosmetic remodels are quicker than full renovations because they require less demolition and construction time. A cosmetic remodel is when you make changes to the bathroom without changing any of the walls or flooring. A full renovation is when you change all of those things as well as replace fixtures and appliances in your bathroom.

AVAILABILITY OF MATERIALS

Other factors that may affect the timeline of a bathroom remodel are deciding what style or layout you want. Bath remodeling contractors can help you make those decisions by providing design plans and samples of different materials to choose from. 

Choosing materials that are readily available helps speed up a job vs. waiting on special-order or backorder materials. Homeowners who are more flexible with their design and product choices will help shorten the remodel timeline for the contractor. However, there are certain steps in the process, like laying tile, that can’t be sped up by much due to the amount of detail work it takes to lay individual tiles.

INSPECTIONS

Inspections are required by law for any home remodeling project. The inspections will be done by the city or county building code officials to ensure the work meets all safety codes. Inspections will also be needed for any new plumbing, electrical, heating and cooling systems that may need updating before the project can start.

EXPERIENCE

Hiring the right person for your bathroom remodel is also important to both the amount of time it takes and the quality of the finished product. It can be tempting to want to DIY a home project or hire the company that gives you the cheapest quote. As a homeowner, you know that cheaper is not always better option. It may cause you more trouble in the long run should you have to fix any problems or botched work.

HOW TO CHOOSE THE RIGHT CONTRACTOR FOR YOUR BATHROOM REMODEL

When it comes to remodeling your bathroom, you want to make sure that you are choosing the right contractor for the job. There are a few things that you should be looking for in order to find a contractor that’s right for you.

Experience: One of the most important aspects of finding a contractor is their experience with bathroom remodels. You want to make sure they have experience so that you can be confident that they know what they are doing. It is also important to research online reviews of contractors to see what others have said about them. You can find reviews on sites like Angie's List and Google.

Communication: You want someone who will communicate well with you throughout the entire process. They should answer any questions that arise along the way in a timely manner. They should be able to provide transparency in regards to their work as well as any issues they may run into along the way so that there are no surprises.

WAYS TO EXPEDITE A BATHROOM REMODEL

The majority of homeowners have a bathroom they would like to remodel quickly. However, the process can be time-consuming, costly, and stressful if you’re not prepared. Here are some tips to expedite your bathroom remodeling project.

Hire a contractor with experience in the type of work you need done.

Be available to answer any questions and make any last-minute decisions that might come up during the project.

Avoid making unnecessary last-minute changes that will increase your costs or delay construction work on your home.

HOW TO PREPARE FOR THE UNEXPECTED

Bathroom remodels are a great way to update your space and make it feel fresh. But before you get started, there are some things you need to consider.

Do I need a permit to remodel my bathroom? Do I need to notify my HOA? What do I do if there is an emergency? These are all good questions that every homeowner should ask themselves before they start the process.

The most important thing when planning a bathroom remodel is making sure that it’s done properly and in compliance with local regulations. That’s why it’s important to choose an experienced bathroom contractor in your area.

Embrace New Ideas & Processes 

Empowerment & Accountability  
Our Consultation Process

We would love to help you get started on your new project! At your initial showroom consultation, you will be able to discuss your overall plans and design goals, so that our designer can provide you with an estimated cost right away. 

​

Prior to your consultation, our designer will ask you for photos and/or relevant information of the space. This allows them to bring your project to life with three-dimensional renderings of your improved space!

 

Once you schedule your in-home measure with your designer, you receive a preliminary estimate, and the fun part begins!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What does an average project cost? 

Typical kitchen, bathroom, and laundry room projects range in price depending on size, materials, and labor needed. 

Full kitchen and master bathroom remodels start at about $35,000, and about $15,000 - $22,000 for laundry rooms and other smaller scaled projects. 

How long does a typical remodel usually take? 

A typical project can range from 6 to 8 weeks. Project timelines can be extended or shortened depending on progress. You see it all! Stevens Kitchens uses a program called BuilderTrend, giving you access to your full project calendar to view at any time. 

Does your company offer financing? 

Yes we do! Our company does have a payment plan that spans throughout your project, but we do, however, offer financing options through multiple financial institutions to meet your needs. For more information, please ask your designer or check our "Contact Us" page to speak to our office. 

How long does an in office consultation typically last? 

In office consultations with our designers can last from 30 minutes to over an hour, depending on the size of your project or number of projects you are looking to complete.

ABOUT GUTHRIE KITCHEN & BATH PLUS

Our team proudly serves the community of Pleasant View and the surrounding region. As a local business and residents of the community, we have a keen understanding what homeowners in our area require. As experts in our industry, we also have an in-depth knowledge of the latest products, styles, and techniques that will help you achieve your dream home design. Our goal is to create designs and offer products that cater to your family’s lifestyle challenges, desires, and budget. We also recognize that updating your home is not a one-size-fits-all endeavor. That is why we offer such a wide range of products and services, to enable us to meet the needs of clients who require a large scale remodel while also helping our neighbors who simply want a fresh coat of paint to brighten up a room.

KITCHEN & BATH SHOWROOM
OUR REMODELING PROCESS
At Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC, our team has a shared vision to give customers the best possible experience, from the moment you pick up the phone to call us or walk into our showroom until the job is complete. A home remodeling project is unique to each homeowner, so our goal is to offer an experience tailored to the individual client. We are passionate about design, and we combine this passion with experience to bring you the best possible service.
WE IDENTIFY YOUR NEEDS

We start by learning about you and your home, what you need, and how we can best serve you.

REALIZE YOUR VISION

We work in partnership with you to create a design that realizes your vision and fits your needs.

EFFECTIVE COMMUNICATION

We believe in the importance of effective communication throughout the design and remodeling process, including a transparent budgeting process.

WE VALUE YOUR TRUST

We value the trust our clients place in our entire team by working with us to enhance their home living environment.

READY TO START YOUR REMODEL?

Our team combines expertise in kitchen and bathroom design, home remodeling, product selection, and much more. Together with our trusted team of sub-contractors, we have everything you need to bring your remodeling project from concept to completion.
MEET THE GUTHRIE KITCHEN & BATH PLUS LLC TEAM!
MIKE GUTHRIE

OWNER

Shortly after graduating high school, Mike went to work for a convenience store chain where he started as a clerk and quickly moved through the ranks to become district manager within four years of starting. In 1982 Mike moved into the construction industry, which led to a customer meeting with the owner of a millwork company who offered a position during the winter months. Once Mike went to work for the millwork company, his passion changed and was hooked on cabinetry, countertops, and the woodworking
READ MORE
BRITTANY CRAMER

ACCOUNTING

Brittany is our billing and accounting specialist at Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus. With her organizational skills, ability to manage deadlines, and expertise with our accounting programs, Brittany plays a central role in our team. She has eight years of bookkeeping experience and enjoys the key part she plays in maintaining accuracy and integrity for Guthrie’s clients. Brittany’s skills and dedication help to meet Guthrie’s goals every day. When she is not at work, Brittany enjoys spending time with her family and keeping fit.

CHRISSY BROWN

PURCHASING

Chrissy has always had an interest in home design and décor, with a passion for textures and colors. She has 20 years’ experience working with homebuilders, first as an Account Manager for workers’ compensation policies. Her role evolved during her career to include working as a Senior Account Manager, where she worked directly with clients while creating processes and procedures to streamline business functions. She was later promoted to Director of Policy Services, where her responsibilities expanded to include managing a team of people and

READ MORE
HEATHER DICKSON

DESIGNER

Heather brings a true love of design and several years of design experience to the Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus team. After majoring in Health and Human Performance at Austin Peay State University, Heather began doing cabinetry design at Lowe’s in 2016. She later moved on to designing full remodels in her role as Project Interior Specialist at Lowe’s. In this role, she was trained on 20/20 Design Software and maintains her certification through ongoing training. She is also currently studying to become NKBA certified.

READ MORE

READY TO START YOUR REMODEL?

Speak with one of our experts today to begin planning your project. We will set up a convenient time to review your project needs and get started on improving your home living spaces!
GET IN TOUCH

TRUSTED BY THE EXPERTS

As leaders in our industry, we proudly partner with these local and national industry organizations.

OUR DESIGN PROCESS

At Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC, our team has a shared vision to give customers the best possible experience, from the moment you pick up the phone to call us or walk into our showroom until the job is complete. A home remodeling project is unique to each homeowner, so our goal is to offer an experience tailored to the individual client. We are passionate about design, and we combine this passion with experience to bring you the best possible service.
LEARN MORE

KITCHEN AND BATH DESIGN SERVICES

We know that the process of transforming your kitchen, bath, or other home living spaces into a unique reflection of yourself is best accomplished when you partner your efforts with a professional designer. You bring us your vision, ideas, pictures, color schemes, and anything else that inspires you. We will help you translate that into a design that fits your requirements. NOT SURE HOW TO START YOUR NEXT PROJECT?

Speak with one of our experts today to begin planning your project. We will set up a convenient time to review your project needs and get started on improving your home living spaces!

HOME DESIGN AND REMODELING HELP

Whether you only need help creating the perfect design and selecting products, or want an experienced company who can handle your entire remodeling project with ease, you have come to the right place. We offer a range of services tailored to your needs so you get the results you deserve for your home.

Do you need help with a design and products, but plan to install yourself or partner with your own contractor? A member of our team will work with you to create a design that expresses your vision for your home, and help you navigate the range of products available to find the ideal cabinetry, countertops, tile, flooring, and more. We will order and deliver these products to your home, so you have everything you need to create your new home living space yourself.

We are also leaders in our industry in full end-to-end design and installation. Let us take the stress out of your kitchen, bathroom, or multi-space remodel by planning, designing, ordering, and installing everything you need to achieve your new home living space. By allowing us to project manage everything from design to installation, you can enjoy the process while our experts take care of every detail for you.

Our team builds partnerships with select local builders to provide designs and products for kitchens, bathrooms, and other spaces in new homes. If you are a local builder, contact us to discuss how we can work together to achieve better home designs!

OUR KITCHEN AND BATH PRODUCTS

Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC is your one-stop-shop for all the products you need to bring out the best in your home. Learn about our wide range of quality product selections from our knowledgeable team members, from cabinetry to countertops, plumbing fixtures, cabinet hardware, flooring, and much more. Whatever you need for your home, we have it! Let our experienced design team help you select and order the ideal products to meet your style and budget considerations.

KITCHEN REMODELING IN NASHVILLE
NASHVILLE KITCHEN REMODELING
KITCHEN DESIGN AND REMODELING

If you are ready to create your ideal kitchen design, you have come to the right place! At Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC, our experienced design team has the knowledge and expertise to help you transform your home with a new kitchen. We understand the kitchen is more than just a place to store and prepare food.

It is the heart of your home, where the family gathers, birthdays are celebrated, and holiday treats are prepared.

You want to create a multi-functional kitchen design that meets the needs of every member of your household. We put our years of experience to work for you to help you identify your needs, find your perfect style, and select the layout and products that will bring your kitchen design vision to life.

We will also help you create a kitchen that meets your family’s needs not just today, but for the lifespan of this remodel. Whether you are a young, growing family, or a couple designing for aging in place, let our team help you design your ideal kitchen.

Bring us your ideas and must-haves so your Guthrie designer can better understand your goals. Start by examining what you like and don’t like about your current kitchen.

If it lacks space, do you have room to expand by knocking down an internal wall or bumping out an external wall? Are you going for a sleek, contemporary style or do you prefer the warmth of  a rustic, farmhouse look? Save pictures of kitchens, color schemes, and materials you love and bring them along to your design consultation.

CONTACT US

If you are still deciding on your preferred style, materials, or storage features for your new kitchen, a visit to our Pleasant View, TN showroom will help! Our full-service design showroom has everything you need to get started on your dream remodel.

Browse styles as you walk through our full kitchen design displays.
See materials first-hand to help you find the ideal cabinetry, countertops, tiles, flooring, plumbing fixtures, and more.
Best of all, talk to our experienced team who can help you create your design and put together the perfect products for your home’s style and budget.

When you work with Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC, you can count on reliable service and quality products. We have a unique understanding of the homes in our area and can help you get the most out of your remodeling investment. Our goal is to give you the best possible experience from the first time we meet until your job is complete. We follow a proven design process to make sure your project is a success.

BATHROOM REMODELING IN NASHVILLE TN

PLAN YOUR BATHROOM REMODEL WITH A DESIGNER

Dreaming of a bathroom that feels like a luxury retreat? Our design team can help you plan every detail, from spacious showers to custom vanities and elegant finishes. Visit our Pleasant View showroom to see materials in person, or schedule a consultation to get started.

SCHEDULE YOUR FREE CONSULTATION
NASHVILLE BATHROOM REMODELING
DESIGN YOUR IDEAL BATHROOM
PARTIAL BATHROOM REMODELS
NOT READY FOR A FULL RENOVATION?

You don’t always need a full renovation to make a big impact. New vanities, updated fixtures, fresh tilework, and modern lighting can completely refresh your bathroom. Ask our designers about affordable ways to enhance your home.

EXPLORE YOUR OPTIONS

Are you ready to update your master bath to a luxury spa-style retreat? Do you need to create a hall bath design suited to your young children and growing family? Or do you want to remodel an existing bathroom or add a first-floor full bathroom designed for aging in place? We can help you create the perfect bathroom designs to fit your home, your family’s needs, and your personal style.

Today’s bathrooms are more than purely functional spaces. They are where you start and end each day, and often serve as a relaxing retreat within your home and busy life. A well-designed bathroom can help you stay organized as you get ready for your day. It can also be your go-to place to wind down with a soak in the tub or a soothing steam shower.

Our experienced design team will help you get the most out of your bathroom layout. We can create a design that works within your existing space or help you expand your bathroom footprint with structural changes. Our team will work with you to find the perfect products, colors, and materials to bring your bathroom design vision to life. 

Let us take the stress out of the remodeling process! Updating your bathroom can seem overwhelming with so many decisions to make – from selecting a layout to choosing a vanity cabinet, tiles, flooring, plumbing fixtures, and accessories. Rely on our expertise and knowledge as we guide you through creating a design, choosing products, and completing your remodel to the highest standards. Get started by contacting our team!

CONTACT US

Your bathroom design needs will vary depending on your personal preferences, available space, accessibility requirements, budget, and more. Start by considering which bathroom you are designing.

If you are updating your powder room or another half bathroom you will typically only require a sink, toilet, and small vanity cabinet to store essentials.

Powder rooms are also an ideal space to experiment with your style by introducing bold color choices, patterned tiles or wallpaper, and fun accessories.

A busy family bathroom or master bath requires enough storage to keep everyone organized. You will also need a toilet plus a shower, tub, or both.

Choose a style and color scheme that fits your home’s design aesthetic and that will create a soothing atmosphere for the bathroom’s users.
 If accessibility is a top priority, we have the expertise to help you create a bathroom that is as safe as it is stylish. Choose from a range of non-slip flooring materials, thresholdless or open shower styles, and easy-to-access doorways.

Make sure your bathroom storage is easy to reach and include plenty of lighting throughout the bathroom. Add accessibility features like grab bars in key locations, with materials and finishes that match your other design features.

MULTI-SPACE REMODELING NASHVILLE TN
MULTI-SPACE REMODELING DESIGN
MULTI-SPACE REMODELING MADE EASY

If your remodeling needs go beyond a single room or a simple style update, the Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC team has you covered. Whether you require a multi-room remodel or a home addition, our team will work with you to create the home of your dreams. With our proven design process, team of experts, and years of experience, we know exactly what it takes to make every remodeling project a success.

Start by considering your remodeling goals. Are you updating your first floor with new flooring, a kitchen remodel, laundry room update, home office design, and a fresh powder room design? Or perhaps you plan to remodel your master suite with new bedroom flooring, a custom closet design, and a spa-style master bathroom remodel? Do you love your home’s location but desperately need to add on more space to your kitchen or create a new family room?

Identify your key objectives and then visit our Pleasant View showroom to browse styles, see products first-hand, and talk to our team. We will walk you through every step of the remodeling process to make sure your project is stress-free and successful. Let’s work together to create your ideal home!

CONTACT US

A multi-space remodel or home addition may seem like a daunting task but it is also an opportunity to bring your dream home to life. We have experience working on design and remodeling projects of all sizes, with a proven track record in delivering value for your remodeling investment. Our team will make sure every detail is handled, from concept to completion, including obtaining permits, ordering products, and carefully managing the timeline for all elements of your project.

Best of all, our Pleasant View, TN showroom is the only location you need to visit to find everything you need to complete your project. No need for endless online searches or driving to multiple locations. View samples first-hand and let your experienced Guthrie designer help you find the perfect products to complete your design. Contact us to get started!

NASHVILLE TN SERVICE AREAS
COUNTIES WE SERVE NEAR NASHVILLE

As local business owners and residents, we are proud to serve our community. We provide the best, most reliable kitchen and bath design and remodeling services to clients in Middle Tennessee. Whether you want our team to design and install your project, or you have your own installer and only need design and product selection services, we are here to help.

CUSTOM CLOSETS MONTGOMERY COUNTY
CUSTOM CLOSET DESIGN SERVICES
CUSTOM PANTRY AND CLOSET SYSTEMS

A custom closet design transforms your space to fit your lifestyle and improve your home’s efficiency. Whether you want to create a master closet design or to update your hall closet, linen closet, or any space that benefits from custom storage, our experienced design and remodeling team can help. We will work with you to understand your individual needs and create a storage plan tailored to your requirements.

Custom closets, particularly for a busy master suite, offer more than just efficient storage. They enhance your daily routine with an organized, well-lit, easy to navigate space that blends with your home’s design aesthetic. In a walk-in closet, you can include custom shelving, drawers equipped with special storage features for clothing and accessories, shoe storage, and bars at different heights for hanging clothes. Include essential lighting so you can see clearly, and enhance your closet’s style with decorative light fixtures.

Other closets, such as a kids’ bedroom closet, hall closet, linen closet, or even a pantry cabinet benefits from customize storage solutions with adjustable shelves, bars and hooks for hanging items, and pull out containers that make contents easy to access. Our experienced team will work with you to understand your requirements and create a storage plan that is catered to your individual needs.

CONTACT US

A fresh start for your closet storage not only improves organization and reduces clutter, it also enhances your home’s value and your daily routine. We all know how frustrating it can be when trying to get ready for work or a night out and you can’t find that perfect outfit or pair of shoes. A new closet design maximizes your available closet space, creating room to neatly store everything you need so it can be easily found.

A closet design is an ideal add-on to a kitchen remodel, bathroom design, or whole home update. We apply our design expertise and creativity to every project and can help you find the perfect storage solutions to enhance your home and lifestyle. Start by visiting our Pleasant View showroom or contact us to speak to a member of our team about your project. We would love to meet with you to review your plans in more detail and discuss how we can help you bring your design vision to life.

FIREPLACE SURROUNDS IN NASHVILLE
FIREPLACE SURROUND DESIGN
DESIGN A COZY FIREPLACE SURROUND

A fireplace design combines beauty and functionality to serve as the centerpiece of living spaces in your home. Fireplaces bring warmth to any room and help to create an inviting atmosphere where you can relax or spend time with guests. If your fireplaces need to be updated, our experienced team can help you create the perfect style and find the ideal materials to add comfort and value to your home.

At Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC we have the experience and knowledge to handle all your home remodeling needs. We can help you craft a custom fireplace design that is tailored to your home’s style and your needs. You will be amazed at how a new fireplace will transform your living spaces. Our team will help you identify your design style and select the perfect materials to seamlessly integrate with your room’s décor. Whether you plan to remodel your fireplace as part of a living room style update or a complete first floor remodel, work with the Guthrie team to get the best results.

CONTACT US

Our team will ensure that every detail is carefully planned and implemented to create the fireplace you always wanted for your living room. Whether you are looking for a sleek, modern fireplace with clean lines or a more traditional hearth with a decorative mantle, we can help you bring your fireplace design vision to life. Beyond the core functional components of a fireplace, there are several key elements to consider when planning your fireplace update, including:

Surround – this is the area outside of your firebox. You can choose a range of materials to surround your fireplace including natural stone, tile, or brick, to create a striking style for your living room’s focal point.
Hearth – this is the floor that extends in front of the firebox. Choose a hearth material that enhances your functionality and style with a safe and durable surface.
Mantle – this is like a shelf above your fireplace and can be as simple or ornate as you like. Select a material and style that complements your room’s design aesthetic, whether that is rustic, contemporary, or traditional. The mantle can also be a place to display decorative items such as framed photographs, allowing you to further personalize your space.

NASHVILLE COUNTERTOP INSTALLATION
KITCHEN COUNTERTOP INSTALLATION
QUARTZ AND GRANITE COUNTERTOPS

For kitchens, bathrooms, utility rooms, and more, countertops are key to your design’s style and functionality. Countertops immediately draw the eye when you walk into a kitchen or bathroom, since they cover such a large, visible surface area. The material, color, veining, and edge you select for your countertops work together with cabinetry and backsplash to help define your room’s style. Your chosen material will also vary widely in terms of durability, heat-resistance, and ease of maintenance.

Carefully consider your design aesthetic when selecting a countertop material, so you can look for one that elevates your home’s style. Think about which space you are remodeling, how you plan to use that space, and how long you plan to stay in your home. A kitchen remodel in your forever home will benefit from investing in a luxury material that will last as long as your kitchen design. On the other hand, a laundry room might work better with a more budget-friendly option. With a wide range of quality countertop materials available, we can help you find the perfect one to fit your needs.

CONTACT US

The Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC team is here to help with all your home remodeling needs. When it comes to choosing a countertop material, our Pleasant View, TN showroom is the only place you need to visit. Our experienced designers can talk to you about your requirements, look at your room’s style, discuss your functional needs, and consider your budget. We will help you find the perfect material to fit your needs and to complement your other design features. Our showroom offers samples and design displays so you can see and feel the materials first-hand.

When you visit our showroom, you can browse samples and ask our experienced team questions to help you understand the pros and cons of each material. Some of the popular options for countertops include luxury materials like granite and quartz, natural options like marble and wood, and budget-friendly laminate. Quartz is one of the most popular choices as it offers the perfect balance of moisture and heat-resistance, easy maintenance, and timeless style.

FLOORING AND TILE INSTALLATION
NASHVILLE FLOORING AND TILE
FLOORING AND TILE FOR EVERY ROOM

With Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC you can feel confident you are getting the best selection of products and services available in our area. Our experienced design and remodeling team is here to help you with all your home remodeling needs, from kitchen to bathrooms, laundry rooms, multi-space remodels, and more. 

Flooring and tile are a key element of any home design. Your floor material must be able to withstand foot traffic, pets, spills, and heavy items. The material that is right for you will vary depending on your home’s style, your family, and the room you are updating. Tile also features in other key areas of kitchen and bath designs, including bathroom walls, shower floors, and backsplashes.

With our partner company, Guthrie Flooring, we can offer you the best selection of products ranging from hardwood to luxury vinyl, tile, carpet, and much more. The combination of Guthrie Flooring’s quality product selection and Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC’s expertise means you will get the best results for your home every time you work with us.

CONTACT US

Your chosen flooring and tile create surfaces in your home that enhance your design while meeting your needs for durability and easy maintenance.  Assess which room you are remodeling and how this space will be used. Is it a room prone to moisture and spills? Is it a busy room with daily foot traffic? Do you have pets who will be walking in and out of this room? Are you willing to follow a careful cleaning and maintenance routine? These questions and more will help you assess your needs and find the ideal materials for your remodel.

Flooring materials range from hardwood to tile, luxury vinyl plank/tile (LVP/T), laminate, carpet, and more. Different materials fit specific areas of your home better, and each has its pros and cons. It’s important to explore your needs, budget, and style preferences with a design professional when choosing the right flooring material for your remodel.

Tile is also used for backsplashes, tub surrounds, and shower enclosures. Tile is one of the oldest materials and is still a popular choice for today’s homes for flooring and much more. It is a versatile material that can be found in an array of sizes, colors, patterns, and shapes to give your room a unique style.

Whether you want our team to design and install your project, or you have your own installer and only need design and product selection services, we are here to help.

LAUNDRY ROOM DESIGN AND REMODEL
CUSTOM LAUNDRY AND UTILITY ROOMS

The Guthrie Kitchen and Bath Plus LLC team is here to help with all your home remodeling needs. We know that you require well-planned, organized, and stylish spaces to keep your home life running smoothly, from kitchens to bathrooms, living rooms, and more.

A well-designed laundry or utility room can transform your daily routine and make the most mundane household chores easier, more efficient, and maybe even more enjoyable! With our experienced design team, we can help you create a beautiful and functional laundry room that is tailored to your available space, your style, and your specific requirements. We put our design expertise and creativity to work to help you maximize storage for laundry and cleaning supplies, improve your room’s layout, and enhance your style.

An upgrade to your laundry room benefits your daily life and your home’s value with improved organization and functionality. We can help you upgrade your existing laundry room, move your laundry to a better location in your home, or add a new laundry room. Your laundry room design can benefit from cabinetry with smart storage solutions to hold everything from laundry products to cleaning supplies and pet paraphernalia. Decide how you plan to use your laundry room and create storage to meet your needs.

CONTACT US

There are several questions to ask yourself when planning your laundry room design. How big is your laundry room? Do you plan to use it solely for laundry, or will it also serve as a general utility room? Will you also use this room for pet products or include a dog washing station? Is this a room where you will wash and dry clothes, or do you also plan to sort, fold, and iron in your laundry room?

Create customized storage  and include pull out hampers to sort your dirty clothes before washing them. Include space to hang delicates to dry, and add room to store your iron and ironing board. Countertop space is ideal for folding laundry, while  a utility sink lets you handwash or rinse tough stains and dirt before washing. Enhance your space by choosing a color scheme, materials, lighting, and accessories that make your laundry room stylish and enjoyable.

MIDDLE TENNESSEE CABINET EXPERTS
CUSTOM KITCHEN AND BATH CABINETS
CABINETRY TO FIT EVERY ROOM

If you have a space in your home that would benefit from storage, we have the cabinetry you need. Our wide selection includes stock, semi-custom, and fully custom cabinetry. A cabinet design is not just for your kitchen. Cabinetry enhances many home living spaces from kitchens to bathrooms, laundry rooms to living rooms. Cabinets form the foundation of your room’s layout, define your style and color scheme, and provide essential storage and workspace.

Let our experienced team help you find the perfect cabinetry to suit your design style, as well as your budget, storage needs, and layout. Start by examining your space to determine what type and how much storage you need. Look at the shape of your room and start planning the layout that will fit your space best. Think about your home’s style and the aesthetic you want to create with your new design.

Then start browsing cabinet materials, styles, and finishes to find the perfect choice for your home. You can find inspiration online or visit our full-service Pleasant View showroom to view design displays and cabinet samples first-hand. This lets you not only see and feel the cabinet doors, but also how they work together with your chosen countertop, tiles, cabinet hardware, and more. Next, consider the storage accessories that sit behind your cabinet doors and help you maintain a clutter-free room. We will work with you to customize your storage to keep even the smallest items organized and accessible.

KITCHEN CABINETS
KITCHEN CABINETS

Kitchen cabinets are the foundation of your kitchen’s layout. They establish your workspaces, provide storage, and set up the flow of traffic throughout your kitchen design. They also set the tone for your room’s style with the door style, material, color, and finish. They are the centerpiece of your kitchen and should be chosen with a quality and style that will last.

BATH VANITY CABINETS
BATH VANITY CABINETS

Bathroom vanity requirements vary widely, depending on the type of bathroom you are designing and your personal needs. Vanities provide essential and functional customized storage in your busy bathrooms, where you can store everything from toiletries and makeup to spare rolls of toilet paper. They also influence your room’s style with your choice of cabinet style and finish, combined with cabinet hardware.

LAUNDRY AND UTILITY CABINETS
LAUNDRY AND UTILITY CABINETS

We know your busy home requires cabinet storage in more than just the kitchen and bathrooms. Laundry, utility, and mud rooms are essential spaces in any home and benefit from storage for all your laundry, cleaning, and pet supplies. Choose cabinets that fit your home’s design aesthetic to create a space that is pleasant as well as functional!

LIVING ROOM CABINETS
LIVING ROOM CABINETS

In a modern home, living rooms are places to live, relax, and spend time with family and friends. Enhance your living room design with cabinets that customize your space. Your cabinets can blend with your room or stand out as a focal point, while also creating storage for books, board games, kids’ art supplies, and much more.

CABINET BRANDS WE CARRY
CUSTOM WOOD PRODUCTS
CUSTOM WOOD PRODUCTS

Custom Wood Products has been offering quality custom cabinetry since 1981, building a company based on integrity, where employees could be proud of the products they produce. They partner with independently owned kitchen and bath design centers like Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC. Their cabinetry offers custom sizes, features, finishes, shapes, and designs, where each client’s cabinetry is made to order. They bring the craftsmanship of an old-fashioned woodworker to their products and stand by their quality, making them an excellent choice for a custom kitchen or bath design.

VIEW SELECTION
HOLIDAY KITCHENS
HOLIDAY KITCHENS

At Holiday Kitchens, quality doesn’t simply mean exceptional materials and craftsmanship. It means creating kitchen cabinetry tailored to the needs and desires of the customer. Whether you prefer the warm comfort of traditional kitchens, the sleek lines and rich tones of today’s European-style kitchens, or the personality of mixed colors and textures in the eclectic kitchens, Holiday Kitchens’ custom cabinet designs are always modeled on the way you live.

VIEW SELECTION
MARSH CABINETRY
MARSH CABINETRY

Marsh Cabinets is a family-owned cabinetry manufacturer with a century-long legacy of innovation, reliability, and service. Established in 1906, it has grown into a key player in the cabinetry industry across the eastern U.S. Their website offers style galleries to inspire homeowners and designers, a style selector tool for customizing cabinetry selections, and information on finding Marsh dealers. It highlights the company’s American-made commitment and its ambition for continued growth and service excellence.

VIEW SELECTION
JSI CABINETRY
JSI CABINETRY

JSI Cabinetry is a manufacturer and distributor of all wood (no particleboard) kitchen and bath cabinetry, available in a wide range of style and colors including stains, paints, and glazes. From its founding in 1997 when it started with only one line of oak kitchen cabinets, it has grown to over 20 styles of kitchen and bath cabinets today, all available for immediate delivery. JSI’s impressive range backs up its mission statement: “To provide affordable fashion for
today’s home.”

VIEW SELECTION
CNC
CNC

The founding principle of CNC is the idea that beautiful and functional kitchen designs should be accessible to everyone. To achieve this goal, CNC provides a large selection of affordable, high-quality kitchen cabinets, countertops, and vanity cabinets. Their products provide value for money, balancing design, quality, and price. CNC has 20 years of experience and innovation in producing accessible cabinet lines, with a loyal client base, and a team dedicated to their brand and quality.  

VIEW SELECTION
WAYPOINT LIVING SPACES
WAYPOINT LIVING SPACES

Waypoint understands that no one remodels their home every year, and therefore your cabinetry needs to be durable and able to meet your functional and style needs for years to come. They offer stylish cabinet designs in the highest quality materials with a lifetime, limited warranty. The Waypoint team prides itself on its high level of craftsmanship, with solid hardwood frames, top-quality materials, and a high standard of construction that meets the rigorous standards set by the American National Standards Institute. They also work hard to produce cabinetry in a sustainable, responsible manner.

VIEW SELECTION
DURASUPREME CABINETRY
DURASUPREME CABINETRY

Dura Supreme Cabinetry offers Framed and Frameless product lines, each with semi-custom to full custom capabilities. Crestwood Cabinetry has traditional, framed cabinet construction and Bria Cabinetry has a frameless (full access) cabinet construction. Both product lines give you the flexibility to choose the features and value that are right for you!

View Selection
BERTCH
BERTCH

For over 40 years, Bertch has been reviving traditional cabinetmaking in the heart of the Midwest. Bertch strives to focus on quality, customer service, and environmentally responsible manufacturing. This family-owned and operated company utilizes the best quality wood and finishes to create distinctive home products. They are committed to responsible stewardship in all their products and manufacturing, including a commitment to reforestation and recycling.

VIEW SELECTION
KITH KITCHENS
KITH KITCHENS

With over 20 years of experience, this family-owned business located in Haleyville, AL offers a complete selection of kitchen, bathroom, and office cabinetry. The Kith family of cabinets includes Kith, Eudora, KithOne, and Mouser Cabinetry, and across these cabinet lines, they provide the highest standards for product excellence and customer service. Kith offers a wide array of door styles, colors, storage solutions, and finishes to provide a fully customized cabinet design.

VIEW SELECTION
NATUREKAST WEATHERPROOF CABINETRY
NATUREKAST WEATHERPROOF CABINETRY

The image shown above is the property of NatureKast, Inc

NatureKraft Weatherproof Cabinetry has been operating since 2009, providing fully weatherproof cabinets that let you expand your cooking, dining, and entertainment spaces to the outdoors. These 100% weatherproof cabinets are designed to give the rich look of real wood without the maintenance requirements. NatureKraft helps to meet the ever-expanding demand for functional and stylish outdoor kitchens to enhance your home life.

KITCHEN COUNTERTOPS FOR EVERY STYLE
Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC is the top destination in Pleasant View and the surrounding area for countertops to suit any style or budget. Talk to our design experts about the ideal countertop materials for any space in your home, including the kitchen, bathroom, or laundry room. Browse style options and colors to find the perfect match for your home that will complement cabinetry, tiles, and accessories. Together with our trusted suppliers, we offer the most extensive range of materials available on the market, plus design expertise to help you decide the right fit for your lifestyle, home, and budget.
STONE KITCHEN COUNTERTOPS
GRANITE

Granite is an igneous rock that forms when magma cools slowly beneath the earth's surface, forming large, easily visible crystals of quartz, feldspar, and mica. Scientifically, an intrusive (plutonic) igneous rock must contain between 10% and 50% quartz to be classified as granite.

MARBLE

Marble is a metamorphic stone formed when limestone is subjected to intense heat, pressure and chemical solutions, causing the stone to reform into an interlocking structure of calcite, aragonite, and sometimes dolomite crystals.

LIMESTONE

Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed of calcium carbonate, plus calcium and/or magnesium. It is formed when layers of minerals (particularly calcite), fine sediment, and the skeletons and shells of marine organisms undergo lithification.

LOCAL COUNTERTOP DISTRIBUTORS
Stone slabs are typically selected at local distributors once you go beyond the basic stone colors. The basic stones are consistent enough in color to be selected from a small sample. Most all other colors should be viewed in there slab form before making you final color selections. We have listed the links for several local stone suppliers for you to be able to browse some of thier inventories online. It is still recommended that you view the actual slab prior to our fabricators building your countertop.
NUL
VIEW ALL DISTRIBUTORS
QUARTZ SURFACE COUNTERTOPS
Quartz is an exceptionally durable material for countertops and are nonporous meaning they are stain and bacteria resistant. They are scratch resistant and easy to clean, and offer excellent options for color, pattern, texture, and finish.

Through superior strength, incredible beauty and an unparalleled distribution network, Silestone is rapidly becoming the choice for discerning consumers. There are many advantages to using Silestone: since it is a surface that is manufactured from natural quartz, it is highly resiliant.

VIEW COLORS

Whether you're looking for a surface that stands up to the demands of daily life, or a surface that resists the wear of commercial applications, Viatera Quartz is available in an array of colors and styles that allow you the freedom to create a space that truly reflects the beauty and wonder of your life.

view colors

Zodiaq® quartz surface brings the best of nature and science to the best of contemporary residential and commercial design. Engineered with pure quartz crystals, beaming with diamond-like radiance, Zodiaq® surfaces are visually striking — and utterly unique.

VIEW COLORS

Caesarstone quartz surfaces are the ultimate combination of nature and technology. Non-porous, scratch resistant and highly resistant to stains, Caesarstone retains its beauty without sealants or waxes and is almost maintenance-free. Ideal for any interior space, with four times the strength.

VIEW COLORS

Cambria is a natural, quartz surfacing product that has a variety of uses in your home or business such as countertops, floor tile, vanities, fireplace surrounds, wet bars, showers, etc. Cambria is pure, natural quartz, one of the hardest and most common minerals on Earth.

VIEW COLORS
SOLID SURFACE COUNTERTOPS
This countertop is made from a solid, synthetic material. Solid surface countertops are nonporous and therefore a very hygienic surface for kitchens or bathrooms. They are a durable countertop that is easy to clean and maintain, and they come in a wide range of colors to fit every style.

DuPont™ Corian® solid surface can be whatever your design imagination commands it to be. Nonporous and stain-resistant, Corian® is easy to clean, making it as ideal a surface for healthcare environments as it is for home kitchens and baths. It's durable and easy to renew, because the color runs all the way through the material.

VIEW COLORS

HI-MACS exudes an undeniable sense of quality, one that is further enhanced by the product's unlimited thermo-formability and enormous range of color options. However, HI-MACS delivers this level of superiority and beauty with a price tag that won't break your budget.

VIEW COLORS

For over 25 years, our leading innovation has created products that push the boundaries and expectations of surfacing and set new product benchmarks for the entire industry. Today, our leadership role in sustainable design and innovation continues beyond the ordinary.

VIEW COLORS

Think the kitchen in your dreams looks good? Wait until you're sitting in it. Staron® Solid Surfaces are made of 100% durable acrylic material and are extremely versatile. Add their hygienic qualities and you can see why we are so often the top choice for commercial spaces and more.

VIEW COLORS

These half-inch thick, 100% acrylic based surface products are solid, nonporous and do not require sealing. They're naturally resistant to heat, mold, mildew and most stains, even tough stains are easily buffed away. They're renewable and repairable — scratches are easily repaired.

VIEW COLORS

Smooth and shapely. The beauty of Formica® Solid Surfacing looks perfectly finished from any angle and offers endless design options, including edgings, accents and inlay for countertops, vanities, sinks or custom applications. We harmonize with natural or manufactured products.

VIEW COLORS
OTHER COUNTERTOP TYPES
We offer countertop materials and styles to suit every style, any space in your home, and a range of budget options. Looking for something different? Our range of countertop options and expertise extends well beyond granite, marble, and quartz. Visit our Pleasant View showroom and talk to our design experts to learn about the pros and cons of other countertop materials to find out which one is right for you.

MATERIALS INCLUDE

Soapstone
Tile
Glass
Stainless Steel

and More!

COUNTERTOP REPAIRS NEEDED?

Want to get more life out of your existing countertop by getting it repaired? We can help! Call us to discuss what repairs are required. We will either work with you directly to make the repairs or we can assist you in finding the right resource to get it repaired. If we find that repair is not an option, we can assist you in finding a replacement for your countertop.
GET IN TOUCH
MORE KITCHEN AND BATH PRODUCTS

We offer much more than just cabinets! Guthrie Kitchen & Bath Plus LLC is the only stop you need to make in Pleasant View and the surrounding area for all your home remodeling products. From basic supplies for a DIY project to a full range of products for a total home remodel, available in a wide range of style and budget options, let us help you select the ideal products to achieve your dream space.

Who We Are
VETERAN & WOMAN OWNED

Established in 2015 as a family-owned and family-run business, C&S Remodeling is among the leading home remodeling contractors near San Antonio. Our company is a team of community-oriented people committed to making a difference in our customers' lives. We are proudly veteran-owned and woman-owned, reflecting our dedication to excellence and diversity.
